objective: isolated minimal native replay REQUEST recorder: per-request finish_reason from actual SSE JSON (absent/contradiction explicit), usage + provenance, first/last content, [DONE], HTTP status, fates, request ids, offered+sent clocks/lag; returns STRICT normalized rows accepted unchanged by sealed nominal_metrics (01) validate_run/compute; usable for native fixed16/fixed32 independently of MPC
not_modified: nominal_metrics.py and sealed metrics01 (no metrics amendment without Parent integration review)

design.schedule: one asyncio task per offered request sleeping to the absolute offered offset offered_start+arrival_seconds; no rescheduling, no catch-up compression, no drop or cherry-pick; late sends keep their schedule and record lag
design.retention: every offered request has exactly one row: placeholder not_launched until sent; send-path surprises unknown; drain-deadline cancellation cancelled
design.finish_reason: collected from every SSE data JSON choice; exactly one distinct non-null value -> observed; none -> absent (row may be complete, natural SLO not good); conflicting values -> contradiction (stream_error, never complete)
design.natural_slo: unchanged r23 score_http fields (status, finish_reason, requested_ignore_eos from the payload actually sent, stream_done, stream_error) + usage.completion_tokens; no TTFT-only substitute
design.model_binding: explicit typed binding record: served public alias == frozen trace.model (trace.model never changed), absolute local model path, tokenizer sha256 == trace provenance tokenizer_sha256, served names include alias, actual launch argv evidence; default REFUSE without binding; runtime /v1/models must list alias with root == local path before offered start
design.full_wall: client never invents setup/drain: run uses offered_cohort_observed envelope unless the driver supplies a same-clock full-wall record (setup start, final drain end, source)
design.no_side_effects: no budget mutation, permit creation, model server launch or gateway control; CPU tests use httpx.MockTransport only (no sockets/HTTP/GPU)

tests: focused failure-sensitive literal controls per Python (py3.14 ROOT/.venv, py3.12 session venv): SSE edge cases (stop, length, absent finish, contradiction, error event, invalid line, missing [DONE], empty content, usage absent/multiple), 503 admission vs other HTTP, transport error, drain cancellation, not_launched retention, binding refusals, normalized rows accepted by nominal_metrics.compute; attempt dirs, one run per attempt, failures preserved
